_comment: Per-group season format for basketball 2026/27 — the input to 'how many home games does this team need?'.
User rule 2026-08-05: 'for games offered assume it's one game home, one game away' — i.e. a
Hin- und Rückrunde. Under that rule a team's HOME games = (teams in its final group) - 1.
⚠ Home games are group size MINUS ONE, not opponentEntriesFor().length. That helper strips every
KSCW entry, and DU18/U20 Rookie holds TWO of ours — DU18 A still plays DU18 B home and away, so
the helper would undercount that group by one. The derby is a real fixture (the games table even
models it as two rows).
STATUS — only 'championship' yields a number. The others render blank with their reason, because
a wrong figure here drives a real filing decision (Lions D1 and Herren 1 must file by 17.08.2026).
championship = the workbook lists this as ONE final group, so size-1 is the home-game count.
provisional  = basketballGroups.ts deliberately holds the WHOLE LEAGUE as a superset; the final
split happens at the Spielplansitzung (that file's own header says so, naming
HU14/HU16 Regional and MixU10/MixU12). Nobody plays 48 home games.
tournament   = not a home-and-away format at all; a host club runs several teams on one day, so
'one home, one away' does not apply.
⚠ Unresolved, flagged rather than guessed: basketballGroups.ts's header comment quotes a group
header as 'D1LRA Saison 26/27 | … | Hin- und Rückrunde | 18 Spiele'. 18 games is a TEN-team
Hin+Rück, and our D1LRA extract holds EIGHT. H1LRA does have ten, so the quote is most likely an
illustrative paste that mixed the two, and 8 teams / 14 games / 7 home is a perfectly normal Damen
1. Liga. But the workbook states the count outright and it was never extracted — if a re-extract
ever captures the 'N Spiele' cell, prefer it over the arithmetic and add it as gamesTotal here.
Keys are the BB_GROUPS keys in basketballGroups.ts, verbatim. Regenerate alongside that file.

DU18/U20 Rookie.note: Holds both DU18 A and DU18 B — see the derby note above.
